title: 第十三章   再遇三阶魔兽
content_zh:
朝阳初升，用光明与温暖柔和地抚触大地，也仿佛是在唤醒着世间的种种生命。此时，琼霄正穿梭于死亡山脉之中。

    进入死亡山脉已有一年的时间，此刻的琼霄已成功晋级为化星境后期巅峰，离*镜只有一步之遥。经过一年的苦修，使得琼霄原本修长的身躯变得更加结实，原本清秀稚嫩的脸庞也开始散发着成熟迷人的气息。

    “先休息一会儿，等会再接着苦修。”原本穿梭的琼霄停了下来，停靠在了一颗大树底下。

    “一年了，好久没见人影了，整天处于与魔兽生死搏杀之中，我都快忘了自己是人了！”靠在树底下的琼霄斜望着上空自嘲的摇了摇头。

    吼！声音刚落下，一束能量朝着琼霄直奔而来，望着极速而来的能量，琼霄随即闪开，能量击中了琼霄原本停靠的大树，嘭！大树瞬间断裂。“好快，好强的攻击，差点就中招了，幸亏我反应快！”闪到一旁的琼霄心有余悸的呢喃道。

    吼！声音又从密林之处传来，密林之处的动作也越来越大，琼霄望着密林之处，小心翼翼着观察着。“这究竟是什么魔兽，好强！比我平时见到的魔兽还强，”琼霄紧盯着前方。

    “差点吃了你一招，我不还你一招怎么行，俗话说的好‘礼尚往来，来而不往非礼也，’说着琼霄回手一抽抓住剑柄然后朝着前方密林处一剑劈了过去。

    嘭！剑气携带着满天尘土朝着前方劈了下去。吼！暴怒的声音也随之而起，一道庞大身影突然跳了出来，对着琼霄就是一声怒吼。

    “我靠，这回真的玩火了，怎么会碰上这魔兽？”望着面前的魔兽，琼霄顿时吓了一跳。在琼霄面前的魔兽是地黄狮，琼霄一眼就认了出来。这是一头三阶魔兽，比起之前的那头紫金苍狼更强，同样是三阶魔兽，但紫金苍狼见到了地黄狮也只有夹着尾巴逃跑的份。

    地黄狮先前的攻击只是驱赶进入它领地的入侵者，没想到琼霄的一个回击居然激怒了这头魔兽。“这回又要拼命了，我倒要看看你这头魔兽有何凶悍之处！”琼霄咧了咧嘴，旋即手持着剑冲了上去。

    地黄狮看着冲来的琼霄，不停的吼着，它没想到居然会有人敢挑衅它，后脚不停地刨着地，最后一头撞了上去。

    砰，砰，砰！一剑挡住了地黄狮的拍来的前脚，琼霄顿时一声胸口闷响，随即后退了几丈之远。“好硬的躯体，我对它的攻击几乎没有任何伤害！今天必须拼命了，要不然就真埋骨于此了！”“喝！”一声低吼琼霄一个健步又冲了上去，一人一兽又开始了战斗。

    “吼！”一声凄厉的声音突然间响彻方圆几里的地方，这声音真是从地黄狮口中传出。此时的琼霄一剑插在了地黄狮的脚上，这个场面分外滑稽，谁能想到，地黄狮居然被琼霄一剑刺中了前脚。琼霄之所以要选择地黄狮的脚作为突破口，是因为地黄狮的脚防御比较薄弱，只有这样才能击伤地黄狮。碰！作为代价，琼霄又是挨了一脚，倒飞而出，重重地在地上划出了深深的痕迹。
content_en:
The rising sun touches the earth softly with light and warmth, and seems to awaken all kinds of life in the world. At this time, Qiong Xiao was traveling through the Death Mountains.

    It has been a year since he entered the Death Mountain. At this moment, Qiong Xiao has successfully advanced to the peak of the late stage of the Star Transformation Realm, and is only one step away from the * Mirror. After a year of hard training, Qiong Xiao's originally slender body became stronger, and her originally delicate and immature face began to exude a mature and charming aura.

    "Rest for a while first, and then continue the hard training later." Qiong Xiao, who was originally shuttled, stopped and stopped under a big tree.

    "It's been a year. I haven't seen anyone for a long time. I've been in a life-and-death fight with monsters all day long. I almost forgot that I was a human!" Qiong Xiao, who was leaning under the tree, looked sideways at the sky and shook his head mockingly.

    roar! As soon as the voice fell, a beam of energy rushed straight towards Qiong Xiao. Looking at the energy coming at a very fast speed, Qiong Xiao immediately dodged away, and the energy hit the big tree where Qiong Xiao was originally parked. Bang! The tree broke instantly. "It's such a fast and powerful attack. I almost got hit. Fortunately, I reacted quickly!" Qiong Xiao murmured with lingering fear as he dodged to the side.

    roar! The sound came from the dense forest again, and the movements in the dense forest became louder and louder. Qiong Xiao looked at the dense forest and observed carefully. "What kind of monster is this? It's so strong! It's stronger than the monsters I usually see," Qiong Xiao stared straight ahead.

    "I almost took a hit from you. How could I not give you a move in return? As the saying goes, 'reciprocity is reciprocated, but it is not polite to reciprocate." As he said this, Qiong Xiao returned his hand, grabbed the hilt of the sword, and slashed towards the dense forest ahead.

    Bang! The sword energy carried the dust all over the sky and slashed forward. Roar! Angry voices also arose, and a huge figure suddenly jumped out and roared at Qiong Xiao.

    "Damn it, I'm really playing with fire this time, how could I encounter this monster? "Looking at the monster in front of him, Qiong Xiao was startled. The monster in front of Qiong Xiao was the Yellow Lion, and Qiong Xiao recognized it at a glance. It was a third-level monster, stronger than the previous Purple-Gold Wolf. It was also a third-order monster, but when the Purple-Gold Wolf saw the Yellow Lion, it could only run away with its tail between its legs.

    The previous attack of the Dihuang Lion was just to drive away the intruders who entered its territory. Unexpectedly, Qiong Xiao's counterattack actually angered the monster. "This time I have to fight hard again, I want to see how ferocious this monster of yours is! "Qiong Xiao grinned, and immediately rushed forward with a sword in hand.

    The Yellow Lion looked at the charging Qiong Xiao and kept roaring. It didn't expect that someone would dare to challenge it. It kept digging its back feet on the ground and finally bumped into it.

    Bang, bang, bang! A sword blocked the forefoot of the Dihuang Lion. Qiong Xiao suddenly heard a muffled sound in his chest and then stepped back a few feet. “It’s such a hard body, my attacks on it barely caused any damage! You must work hard today, otherwise your bones will be buried here! ""drink! "With a low roar, Qiong Xiao rushed forward with a vigorous step, and one man and one beast started fighting again.

    "Ho! "A shrill voice suddenly resounded for several miles around. This voice really came from the mouth of the Dihuang Lion. At this time, Qiong Xiao stabbed the Dihuang Lion's foot with a sword. This scene was particularly funny. Who would have thought that the Dihuang Lion was actually stabbed in the front foot by Qiong Xiao's sword. The reason why Qiong Xiao chose the Dihuang Lion's feet as a breakthrough was because the Dihuang Lion's feet were relatively weak in defense. Only in this way could the Dihuang Lion be injured. As a price, Qiong Xiao was kicked again and flew backwards, leaving deep marks on the ground.
title_en: Chapter 13: Encountering the third-level monster again
